descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S14 「TFA-94609 的问卷触发（PR #86，不在 main 上）：第一周 baseline 再弹、每天下午 4–5 点左右的反馈、pilot 结束时弹一次的任务提醒问卷」 TFA-94609 survey triggers (PR #86, not on main): baseline re-offers across the first week, daily feedback around 4-5 PM, the task-reminder survey once at pilot end

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T5 Baseline trigger rules: once at pilot start before first real use; 'Not now' dismisses it; it shows 2-3 more times that week, no more than once a day, then stops; once answered it never shows again（TFA-94609 Spec 1；TFA-94609 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94609 ready for pr
  • T3 The General Feedback survey shows once per day, at around 4-5 PM (end of the rounding day, not morning), dismissible, no forced completion（TFA-94609 AC 3；TFA-94609 Spec 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94609 ready for pr
  • T4 All surveys are dismissible, with no forced completion（TFA-94609 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-94609 ready for pr
  • U9b The Task-Reminder survey fires once, at pilot end only, with the specified copy: 'When you dismissed a task reminder, was it usually because you'd already done it, or because it wasn't relevant anymo …（UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1；TFA-94609 AC 2；TFA-94609 Spec 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-94609 ready for pr

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Fresh physician; the device clock under the harness's control; the pilot end date set by the pilot team

When Baseline: Not now on day 1, then open the app on days 2-7 (twice on day 2). Feedback: open the lists at 15:59, 16:00, 17:00 and 17:01; dismiss on one day, answer on the next. Task reminder: open the lists before the end date and on it, answer (or Not now), open again the next day

Then Baseline: offered at most once a day, 2-3 more times in the week after the first Not now, then never; never after an answer. Feedback: not before about 4 PM, shown once that day, dismissible with no forced completion, back the next day. Task reminder: not shown before the end date; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94609 Spec 1 / Spec 3 / Spec 4 / AC 1-4. 'Once' vs re-offer is Q1; whose clock and whether 5 PM is a cutoff is Q14; who owns the end-of-pilot survey is Q7. Main has none of these rules (24 h snooze every day, recorded in S13 R7; feedback only in Settings; surveyResponses accepts only baseline, handoff_followup, feedback); they arrive with PR #86

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S14 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
